about.label: About Tawer Academy
about.title: Built by teachers who wanted English to [[feel alive]].
about.text: Tawer means growth. We help learners of every age turn English from a school subject into a skill they **actually use**, in their studies, at work and abroad.
about.storyText: It started with two teachers, one rented classroom and six students who were tired of memorising grammar tables. We built every lesson around real conversation, and word spread. Today Tawer teaches learners from age 6 to 60 in live online classes, wherever they are.

levels.label: Course levels
levels.title: One clear path from [[A1 to C1]]
levels.text: Our levels follow the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), the international standard used by universities and employers. Pick a level to see what you'll be able to do.

items.name: Beginner
items.intro: Your first steps in English. No previous knowledge needed.
can: Introduce yourself and others
Ask and answer simple personal questions
Order food, shop and ask for directions
Understand slow, clear everyday speech

items.name: Elementary
items.intro: Build confidence for everyday situations and simple conversations.
can: Talk about your past, work and family
Handle travel and hotel situations
Write short messages and emails
Follow the main point of short announcements

items.name: Intermediate
items.intro: The independent-user level: express opinions and keep a conversation going.
can: Describe experiences, plans and ambitions
Give reasons and explain opinions
Deal with most situations while travelling
Understand the main points of TV and podcasts

items.name: Upper-Intermediate
items.intro: Fluent, spontaneous English for work, study and university entry.
can: Take part in discussions and meetings
Write clear, detailed essays and reports
Understand films and native-speed speech
Prepare for IELTS 6.0–6.5 / Cambridge B2 First

items.name: Advanced
items.intro: Precise, flexible English for professional and academic life.
can: Present and negotiate with confidence
Use idioms and nuance naturally
Read complex academic and business texts
Prepare for IELTS 7.0+ / Cambridge C1 Advanced

test.label: Free placement test
test.title: What's your English level? Find out in [[3 minutes]].
test.text: Answer 10 quick questions. We'll estimate your CEFR level and recommend the course that fits you. No sign-up needed.
perks: Speaking check in your free trial
test.startText: 10 grammar & vocabulary questions, from beginner to advanced. Don't guess. If you don't know, choose "I don't know".

questions.q: She ___ a teacher at the local school.
I ___ to the cinema with my friends last weekend.
If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
By the time we arrived, the film ___.
I wish I ___ more free time to read.
He suggested ___ a taxi because it was late.
The meeting was ___ because the manager was ill.
Hardly ___ the house when it started to pour.
His explanation was so ___ that nobody could follow it.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions? [[We've got answers.]]
faq.text: Can't find what you're looking for? Message us on WhatsApp and a coordinator will reply within the hour.

items.q: How do I know which level to join?
items.a: Take our free 3-minute online placement test, then a short speaking check with a teacher during your free trial lesson. We place you in the right CEFR level, from A1 to C1.

items.q: How many students are in a class?
items.a: Group classes have a maximum of 8 students, so everyone speaks in every lesson. Kids' classes are capped at 6.
We teach children from 6 years old, teenagers and adults. Kids and teens are grouped by age and level, with playful, project-based lessons.
Yes. After passing each level's final assessment you receive a Tawer Academy certificate stating your CEFR level, which you can add to your CV or university application.

items.q: How do the online classes work?
items.a: All classes are live with a real teacher in a small group (or private): you see, hear and talk to each other in real time. Lessons are recorded so you can watch them again.

items.q: What if I miss a lesson?
items.a: All online lessons are recorded, and you can join a make-up class in another group at the same level during the same week.
